description: This file defines the Store2 class, which implements gRPC client functionality for secure storage operations, including setting, getting, deleting keys and namespaces, and managing notifications. It also includes methods for retrieving environment-based configuration and system state checks.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A gRPC client class for secure storage operations, supporting environment-based configuration, system state checks, and notification management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the gRPC stub with the specified URI and credentials.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks if the system time is synchronized, optionally using system manager calls if WITH_SYSMGR is defined.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current authentication token via the IAuthService interface.

methods.name: GetPartnerId
methods.description: Reads the partner ID from a file.

methods.name: GetAccountId
methods.description: Reads the account ID from a file.

methods.name: GetDeviceId
methods.description: Reads the device ID from a file.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for value changes.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in secure storage with optional TTL, notifying observers on success.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL from secure storage.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from secure storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Store2 instance with a service shell.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of a value change.
